definitions.explanation: Feeling or realizing something deeply, often after careful reflection or repeated experience.

examples.japanese: つくづく⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{無力|むりょく}→無力：13419_muryoku⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I deeply felt my own powerlessness.

examples.japanese: つくづく⟦{嫌|いや}→嫌：10232_iya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つくづく⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧な⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: Looking at his face intently, I thought he had changed.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- つくづく⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ (to deeply feel/realize)
- つくづく⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to keenly feel)
- つくづく⟦{嫌|いや}→嫌：10232_iya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become thoroughly fed up)
- つくづく⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to look at intently/searchingly)

USAGE:
Often used when reflecting on something and coming to a deep realization, frequently about negative aspects of oneself or a situation. Can express resignation, regret, or profound awareness.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦しみじみ→しみじみ：06715_shimijimi⟧: similar meaning but often warmer/more nostalgic
- ⟦{痛切|つうせつ}→痛切：15228_tsuusetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: more formal, emphasizing painful realization

KANJI FORM:
{熟々|つくづく} exists but hiragana is standard.
